cc:Work.dc:title: JevAny-27B v0.2 checkpoint accuracy
cc:Work.dc:description: Transfer (1,046 questions): SFT 82.41%, RLCR 82.31%. MMLU-Pro (200-question subset): SFT 73.0%, RLCR 73.5%. AI2D (Held-out subset): SFT 86.0%, RLCR 87.0%. MMMU (Held-out subset): SFT 68.0%, RLCR 63.0%. MMStar (1,330 after filtering): SFT 74.5%, RLCR not evaluated. MVBench (3 tasks / 600 questions): SFT 33.5%, RLCR not evaluated.
